 Japan is about to change how international visitors save on shopping, and travelers planning to bring home souvenirs, cosmetics and Japanese food gifts will need to prepare for the new rules. Starting Nov. 1, 2026, eligible tourists must pay the full price, which includes consumption tax, at participating stores and complete a customs procedure before leaving the country to qualify for a refund.
 Japan is changing how visitors save on souvenirs, and the final step happens before you board.
